caption: The drawing depicts a large wooden barrel that is colored in different shades of green, with its staves shown in vertical panels and reinforced by several horizontal brown metal bands. The barrel has a round opening at the top through which two objects protrude—one is a long, straight stick, and the other is a coiled, spiral-shaped implement, both colored in brown and tan tones. The inner rim of the barrel's lid appears tan with dark accents, suggesting shading and possible wear. The composition is centered, with the barrel occupying most of the space, set against a plain, uncolored background. There is a subtle rectangular border around the drawing, and a signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Butter Churn
